::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 17th [1867]  
**From:** [Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.]  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 172-173
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
Would you be so kind as to send an order for me for Sir F. Palgraves [History of Normandy and England](other_books/otherbook_479.qmd). I cannot get my [Cameo’s](cmy_books/cmybook_73.qmd) [sic] correct without it, and [Dr Moberly](people/person_1015.qmd)’s copy on which I reckoned proves to be packed up for leaving Winchester so as to be unobtainable. I can do nothing till I get it, and though I could order it from the [London Library](organizations/other_29.qmd), one is kept often very long waiting for that kind of book.

If I knew who was the publisher I would write direct, but I cannot remember.

Pray tell [Mrs Craik](people/person_378.qmd) when you see her that [Mme de Witt](people/person_423.qmd) writes to me that [M Guizot](people/person_597.qmd) considers her '[Two Marriages](other_books/otherbook_481.qmd)' '<u>comme un chef d’ouvre</u>' [sic]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** The printed address has been cut out of the MS.
